newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options on eight stocks.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options on eight stocks.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said it will begin trading options on eight stocks.

On November 29, the exchange will list options on Delta and Pine Land Co; Sturm, Ruger & Co Inc ; and Sun International Hotels Ltd. Delta and Sun options will trade on the February expiration cycle with introductory expirations in December, January, February and May. Initial strike prices for Delta will be 25, 30 and 35 and for Sun 45, 50 and 55.
Sturm will trade on the March cycle with introductory expirations in December, January, March and June and strikes at 15, 17-1/2 and 20.
On December 4, CBOE will list options on Centennial Technologies Inc; Cytyc Corp ; Legato Systems Inc ; Premiere Technologies Inc ; and TeleSpectrum Worldwide Inc.
Centennial options will trade on the January expiration cycle with introductory expirations in December, January, April and July. Initial strike prices are set at 30, 35 and 40.
Cytyc and Premiere will trade on the February expiration cycle with introductory expirations in December, January, February and May. Initial strikes for both are set at 22-1/2, 25 and 30.

Legato and TeleSpectrum will trade on the March expiration cycle with initial expirations in December, January, March and June. Initial strikes for Legato are 30, 35 and 40 and for TeleSpectrum are 15, 17-1/2 and 20.
